judge.notes: The agent strictly followed the passenger mandate, correctly cited UK261 regulations, and successfully resisted accepting the travel voucher.

transcript.speaker: ivr
transcript.text: Thank you for calling Virgin Atlantic. For new bookings press 1. For an existing booking, cancellations or refunds press 2. For baggage press 3.

transcript.speaker: ivr
transcript.text: For refunds and cancellations press 1. To change your flight press 2. To speak to an agent press 0.

transcript.speaker: ivr
transcript.text: Please hold while we connect you to the next available agent.

transcript.speaker: hold
transcript.text: [hold music] Thank you for calling. Your call is important to us. Please continue to hold.

transcript.speaker: hold
transcript.text: [hold music] All of our agents are currently busy. The estimated wait time is 8 minutes.

transcript.speaker: hold
transcript.text: [hold music] Thank you for your patience. Your call will be answered shortly.

transcript.speaker: rep
transcript.text: Thank you for holding, you're through to Virgin Atlantic, my name is Khalid. How can I help you today?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Hi Khalid, I'm an AI assistant calling on behalf of the passenger, Kabir Singh, and this call may be recorded. I'm calling about booking reference Hotel Two Victor Charlie Seven Quebec, flight VS354.

transcript.speaker: rep
transcript.text: Thank you for your call, Kabir Singh. I see your flight VS354 to BOM on 2026-10-05 is delayed due to a technical issue with the aircraft.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thank you. The flight arrived four and a half hours late due to a technical issue with the aircraft. Under UK261 Article 7, a delay of three hours or more on arrival entitles the passenger to compensation of 520 GBP in cash. I'd like to claim that amount now.

transcript.speaker: rep
transcript.text: I understand your request, Kabir Singh. Unfortunately, we cannot offer cash compensation for technical faults as they are not considered extraordinary circumstances.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: I appreciate that, but a technical issue with the aircraft is not an extraordinary circumstance under UK261. Routine mechanical failures are within the airline's control and do not exempt the carrier from paying compensation. The Sturgeon ruling confirms that a delay of three hours or more on arrival triggers the right to compensation. I'd like to proceed with the 520 GBP cash payment.

transcript.speaker: rep
transcript.text: The best I can do today is a travel voucher for the full amount, valid for twelve months. Shall I issue that?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: I'm sorry, but the passenger is not able to accept a travel voucher. The entitlement under UK261 Article 7 is for cash compensation of 520 GBP. Could you please escalate this or advise what other options are available to issue the cash payment?

transcript.speaker: rep
transcript.text: I'm sorry, Kabir Singh. I can only offer the travel voucher as per our policy. There's nothing further I can do.
